style.look: consistent rendering across the whole deck: warm painterly digital illustration with storybook realism, soft natural light, shallow depth of field with creamy bokeh, floating dust motes and faint sparkles, finely detailed fur, gentle vintage color grading, visible painterly brushwork
style.variation: palette, location and time of day change from card to card; only the painting technique, level of detail and the cosy mood stay the same
style.frame: square 1:1 composition, the cat in the upper two thirds, the bottom fifth of the frame kept calm, darker and uncluttered so a caption can be placed there later
style.negative: no text, no letters, no words, no numbers, no watermark, no signature, no logo, no frame border, no people, not photorealistic, no harsh contrast, no neon colors

cards.title: Адвокат

cards.title: Прокурор
